name: Bridge Between Fear and Dreams
source:
It has been pass down through generations that a ghostly bridge will appear to ones that desires it most. The Bridge on the right path will lead someone to the land of dreams and a new life. Though the bridge isn't all a dream.

Some say that the bridge is the very same bridge that will lead you into the after life when your time comes.

Time blends together and you could become lost forever walking the bridge or give up and disappear.

Dreamers can make the bridge appear but can a dreamer take that chance and make this journey?

[From the opening scene]
translation:
一个传说世代流传：一座幽灵般的桥，会出现在最渴望它的人面前。只要走上正确的道路，这座桥就能带人抵达梦之国，开启新的人生。然而，它并不只是一个美梦。

有人说，当生命走到尽头时，引领人们前往来世的，也是这同一座桥。

时间在这里交融。你可能永远迷失在桥上，也可能放弃前进，就此消失。

追梦者能够让桥出现，但追梦者真的敢抓住机会，踏上这段旅程吗？

[摘自开场场景]
